name: Kirge Sternhorn
summary: In the Barrens, Kirge Sternhorn guides travelers across central Kalimdor. He watches the southern trails and sends new Horde adventurers north to the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Wayfarer in the Barrens
sections.body: For new wanderers, the sun-baked Barrens can feel daunting. Kirge Sternhorn watches over travelers south of the central trails, between the southern camps and the heart of Kalimdor. Quilboar and fierce predators roam the savanna, so Kirge helps young adventurers find their footing. He sends them toward the greater Horde presence gathering in the north.

faq.answer: Kirge Sternhorn guides travelers through the southern Barrens. The tauren helps Horde travelers cross the dusty plains.
Kirge directs travelers north to the Crossroads, the Barrens’ central junction. Horde forces coordinate defense and exploration across the region from there.

faq.q: What faction does Kirge Sternhorn serve?
faq.answer: Kirge is loyal to the Horde and his fellow tauren. He guides and assists all Horde members traveling through the territory.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may recognize Kirge’s welcoming spirit as he guides fellow kin and allies through their harsh homeland.
As a member of the Horde, you can follow Kirge’s directions from the southern reaches toward the greater Horde community at the Crossroads.
